papers.title: Arthralgia and fever as dominant predictors of Chikungunya confirmation: an explainable artificial intelligence approach
papers.abstract: The clinical differentiation of Chikungunya from other acute febrile illnesses poses a significant diagnostic challenge due to the substantial symptom overlap among co-circulating arboviruses such as Dengue and Zika, particularly in resource-constrained settings where laboratory confirmation is frequently delayed or unavailable. This study proposes an interpretable machine learning framework for the prediction of laboratory-confirmed Chikungunya cases versus suspected cases that were subsequently discarded after laboratory investigation, using a large-scale, nationally representative dataset of 12,709 notification records derived from Brazil's Information System for Notifiable Diseases (SINAN), spanning 2013 to 2020 and encompassing 26 clinical symptom, comorbidity, and sociodemographic features. Four supervised learning algorithms—Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM—were systematically evaluated under 5-fold stratified cross-validation, with Random Forest achieving the highest discriminative performance (AUC = 0.785 ± 0.005) and XGBoost demonstrating the best probability calibration reliability. Considering the trade-off between discrimination and calibration, XGBoost was identified as the most suitable model for potential clinical deployment. To ensure clinical transparency, a structured three-level SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) interpretability analysis was conducted on both gradient boosting models, encompassing global feature importance ranking, feature-level directional and interaction effects, and local patient-level prediction decomposition. The SHAP analysis consistently identified arthralgia (mean |SHAP|: 0.7407 in XGBoost, 0.7489 in LightGBM) and fever (0.5043 and 0.4881, respectively) as the two dominant predictors of Chikungunya confirmation, followed by age, education level, and rash, while comorbidities contributed negligibly to case discrimination. Cross-model validation between XGBoost and LightGBM revealed highly concordant feature importance rankings and directional effect patterns, confirming that the identified clinical predictors are robust and independent of algorithmic choice. These findings demonstrate the practical value of combining machine learning with SHAP-based explainability for supporting clinical triage of suspected arboviral cases, providing a transparent, evidence-based diagnostic support tool that aligns data-driven insights with established clinical knowledge and enables personalized patient-level explanations at the point of care. Importantly, the model distinguishes confirmed Chikungunya from discarded suspected cases rather than from confirmed infections with other specific arboviruses, and its predictions should be interpreted within this operational context.
papers.summary_zh:
【公司金融】基孔肯雅热与其他急性发热疾病的临床鉴别存在显著挑战，因为同时流行的虫媒病毒（如登革热和寨卡病毒）的症状存在大量重叠，尤其是在资源有限的环境中，实验室检测常常延迟或无法进行。本研究提出了一种可解释的机器学习框架，用于预测经实验室确诊的基孔肯雅热病例与经过实验室检查后被排除的疑似病例。该框架使用了来自巴西传染病信息系统（SINAN）的大规模、具有全国代表性的数据集，包含12,709条记录，时间跨度为2013年至2020年，涵盖了26种临床症状、合并症和社会人口统计特征。研究人员系统评估了四种监督学习算法——逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）、随机森林（Random Forest）、XGBoost和LightGBM——在5折分层交叉验证下的性能。其中，随机森林的鉴别能力最强（AUC = 0.785 ± 0.005），而XGBoost在概率校准方面表现最佳。综合考虑鉴别能力和校准效果，XGBoost被认为是最适合临床应用的模型。

为确保临床透明性，研究人员对这两种梯度提升模型进行了结构化的三级SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）可解释性...。研究方法：回归分析、机器学习。

papers.title: Particle Wave Detection (PAWD): A Unified Framework for Signal Processing Across Sensing Modalities
papers.abstract:
This paper presents the Particle Wave Detection (PAWD) framework, a two-axis taxonomy for
organizing sensing and signal-processing pipelines across optics, radar, sonar, and terahertz
domains. The axes—measurement domain (intensity versus time-resolved) and processing representation (spectral versus non-spectral)—yield four regimes whose signal models,
complexity scaling, and design trade-offs are formalized and compared. Representative evidence from material detection, spatiotemporal object detection, and liquid purity assessment
demonstrates that temporal non-spectral processing at O (𝑁 ×𝐵) retains strong discriminative
power relative to spectral temporal alternatives at O (𝑁 × 𝐵 × 𝐾). PAWD provides a practical
scaffold for cross-community method comparison and modality-aware system design.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了粒子波检测（PAWD）框架，该框架是一种双轴分类体系，用于整合光学、雷达、声纳和太赫兹领域中的传感与信号处理流程。这两个轴分别是：测量域（强度与时间分辨）和处理表示方式（光谱与非光谱）。基于这两个轴，可以划分出四种处理方式，这些方式的信号模型、复杂度特性及设计上的权衡都得到了系统的阐述与比较。来自材料检测、时空目标检测以及液体纯度评估等领域的实际应用案例表明，时间非光谱处理方法（计算复杂度为O(N×B)）相较于光谱时间处理方法（计算复杂度为O(N×B×K)）仍具有更强的区分能力。PAWD为跨学科方法比较以及基于不同感知模式的系统设计提供了实用的框架支持。。

papers.title: Effects of interviewers on response to income and wealth items
papers.abstract: Item nonresponse to financial questions is a persistent source of survey error, especially in interviewer-administered surveys. We examine whether interviewers' expectations about respondents' willingness to report income are associated with actual item responses to income and asset questions in Wave 6 of the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE). Using data from 41,934 respondents in 12 countries, linked to interviewer survey and roster information, we analyze responses to four financial items with substantial nonresponse. We compare three approaches to handling missing covariates: complete-case analysis, multiple imputation (fill-in methods), and a generalized missing-indicator framework with information-criterion-based model averaging. Across most specifications, respondents interviewed by interviewers with higher expected income response rates are more likely to provide financial information. However, model averaging does not yield clear gains over simpler approaches. The results suggest that interviewer expectations contain useful information for understanding and modeling item nonresponse to sensitive financial items, with potential implications for interviewer training and survey fieldwork design.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在调查中，对财务相关问题的遗漏回答一直是导致误差的持续因素，尤其是在由调查员亲自进行的调查中。我们研究了调查员对受访者报告收入意愿的预期，是否与欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）第六波数据中关于收入和资产问题的实际回答情况存在关联。利用来自12个国家的41,934名受访者的数据（这些数据与调查员的调查记录及受访者名单信息相链接），我们分析了四个财务问题项中存在大量遗漏回答的情况。我们比较了三种处理缺失协变量的方法：完整案例分析、多重插补（填充方法），以及基于信息准则的模型平均化的广义缺失指示器框架。在大多数情况下，由预期收入回答率较高的调查员进行访谈的受访者更有可能提供财务信息。然而，模型平均化方法相较于简单方法并未带来显著的优势。研究结果表明，调查员的预期包含了有助于理解和建模敏感财务问题项遗漏回答情况的有用信息，这对调查员培训及调查现场工作设计具有一定的启示意义。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Risk-Constrained Kelly for Mutually Exclusive Outcomes: CRRA Support Invariance and Logarithmic One-Dimensional Calibration
papers.abstract: We study the finite mutually exclusive outcome version of risk-constrained Kelly optimization with explicit state prices. The market has outcome probabilities $p_i>0$, state prices $q_i>0$, terminal wealths $W_i=c+x_i/q_i$, and a drawdown-surrogate constraint \[ \sum_{i=1}^n p_i W_i^{-λ}\le 1,\qquad λ>0. \] For constant relative risk aversion utility, we work primarily in the standard overround regime $\sum_i q_i>1$, where every optimizer is necessarily non-full-support. Under the usual unique likelihood-ratio prefix hypothesis for the unconstrained problem, we prove that the constrained optimizer has exactly the same active set. Thus, in the regime where the prefix theorem is meaningful, the risk constraint deforms the funded wealth profile but does not change the active set. The support is therefore invariant across both the CRRA parameter and the drawdown-surrogate parameter.   We then isolate the logarithmic case $γ=1$. Once the common active prefix is known, the constrained problem reduces to a one-dimensional outer calibration together with independent one-dimensional inner equations on the active states. In this case we prove existence, uniqueness, and monotonicity for the inner solves, derive a complete calibration theorem, and record the resulting structured algorithm. We treat the fair and subfair regimes only as boundary cases: full-support phenomena can occur there, so the overround prefix theory no longer yields a parallel exact description of comparable sharpness. A numerical example illustrates how the risk constraint alters the funded wealth profile while leaving support unchanged.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了在具有显式状态价格的情况下，风险约束下的Kelly优化问题的有限互斥结果版本。市场中的结果概率为$p_i>0$，状态价格为$q_i>0$，最终财富为$W_i=c+x_i/q_i$，同时存在一个回撤替代约束\[ \sum_{i=1}^n p_i W_i^{-λ}\le 1,\qquad λ>0 \]。在相对风险厌恶效用为常数的情况下，我们主要研究标准超额机制（$\sum_i q_i>1$），在该机制下每个优化器的支持集必然是非完全的。在无约束问题的常见唯一似然比前缀假设下，我们证明了受约束优化器的活跃集与无约束优化器的活跃集完全相同。因此，在前缀定理成立的范围内，风险约束虽然会改变资金配置情况，但不会影响活跃集的构成。由此可见，无论相对风险厌恶参数（CRRA）还是回撤替代参数如何变化，活跃集的构成都是不变的。接下来我们专门研究了对数情况（$\gamma=1$）。一旦确定了共同的活跃前缀，受约束问题就简化为一个一维的外部校准问题，以及关于活跃状态的一维内部方程组。在这种情况下，我们证明了内部解的存在性、唯一性和单调性，推导出了一个完整的校准定理，并记录了相应的算法流程。我们...。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Assessing the effectiveness of Greenblatt’s Magic Formula across international stock markets: Literature review
papers.venue: Research Papers in Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This article presents a comprehensive literature review assessing the effectiveness of Joel Greenblatt’s Magic Formula in international equity markets. The strategy is a value-investing approach based on return on capital (ROC) and earnings yield (EY) metrics. Its primary objectives are to evaluate whether the strategy generates excess returns and to identify factors influencing its performance. The analysis synthesises empirical studies from the US, European (primarily Nordic), Brazilian and Asian markets, incorporating methodological considerations such as data sources, investment universes and systematic biases (e.g. look-ahead bias and survivorship bias). Key findings reveal that the Magic Formula outperforms benchmarks in most markets; however, its effectiveness is contingent on transaction costs (frequently eroding alpha), firm size, market conditions and metric modifications. Simpler strategies (e.g. those relying solely on EY) occasionally yield superior results. The review concludes that the Magic Formula represents a robust, albeit imperfect, tool for exploiting stock market inefficiencies. Future research directions include analyses of post-2020 periods, formula modifications and hybrid approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本文对Joel Greenblatt提出的“神奇公式”在国际股票市场中的有效性进行了全面的文献综述。该策略是一种基于资本回报率（ROC）和收益收益率（EY）的价值投资方法，其主要目的是评估该策略是否能够产生超额回报，并识别影响其表现的因素。研究综合了来自美国、欧洲（主要是北欧国家）、巴西和亚洲市场的实证研究，同时考虑了数据来源、投资范围以及系统性偏差（如前瞻性偏差和生存偏差）等方法学问题。关键研究发现，“神奇公式”在大多数市场中均优于基准指数；然而，其有效性受到交易成本（这些成本往往会侵蚀超额回报）、企业规模、市场条件以及指标调整等因素的影响。一些较为简单的策略（例如仅依赖收益收益率的策略）偶尔也能取得更好的投资结果。综述认为，“神奇公式”是一种可靠但并不完美的工具，可用于利用股票市场的非有效性。未来的研究方向包括对2020年之后的市场进行分析、对公式进行改进，以及探索混合投资策略的应用。。

papers.title: The Empathy Channel in Fertility -- by Sebastian Galiani, Raul A. Sosa
papers.abstract: Being around babies makes people want babies. We formalize this observation as the empathy channel: exposure to infants in the social environment activates neurobiological mechanisms that increase the desire for parenthood. As children become scarcer, this affective stimulus weakens, further eroding the motivation to have children. We embed the mechanism in a two-group overlapping-generations quantity-quality model. The empathy channel generates a positive externality, since each birth raises others’ desire for children, making the decentralized equilibrium inefficient. We characterize the optimal per-child subsidy and show that the first-order Pigouvian rate substantially overshoots the general-equilibrium optimum. The optimal targeting rule follows a Ramsey-like logic, directing the subsidy at the group with the most externality per fiscal dollar, not the group with the largest externality per child. The calibrated model suggests that the empathy channel can account for 3–33% of the fertility decline, with 13.4% at the baseline. At this baseline, the Pigouvian overshoot is 23–32% and the optimal subsidy raises welfare by 0.22% in consumption-equivalent terms.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】与婴儿接触会让人产生想要孩子的愿望。我们将这一现象称为“共情机制”：在社会环境中接触婴儿会激活某些神经生物学机制，从而增强人们成为父母的愿望。随着儿童数量的减少，这种情感刺激逐渐减弱，进一步削弱了生育的动力。我们将这一机制纳入一个包含两组人群、且世代重叠的数量-质量模型中。共情机制会产生正外部性，因为每个新生儿的诞生都会提高其他人对孩子的需求，从而导致分散决策下的均衡效率低下。我们确定了最优的儿童补贴水平，并发现一阶庇古税（Pigouvian tax）的税率会大幅超过一般均衡下的最优水平。最优的补贴分配规则遵循类似拉姆齐（Ramsey）的逻辑，将补贴定向给予每单位财政支出产生最大外部性的群体，而非每名儿童产生最大外部性的群体。根据校准后的模型，共情机制可以解释3%至33%的生育率下降现象；在基准情景下，这一比例约为13.4%。在这一基准情景下，庇古税的超额效应为23%至32%，而最优补贴政策可使福利水平提高0.22%（以消费等值单位衡量）。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Profit Regulation and Strategic Transfer Pricing by Vertically Integrated Firms: Evidence from Health Care -- by Pragya Kakani, Eric Yde, Genevieve P. Kanter, Richard G. Frank, Amelia M. Bond
papers.abstract: We provide evidence of strategic transfer pricing by vertically integrated health care firms in response to insurer profit regulations. Insurers increased prices at vertically integrated pharmacies by 9.5% following the introduction of caps on insurer profits in Medicare Part D. We detect larger price increases by insurers that were at greatest risk of exceeding the allowable profit level. More than one-fifth of these higher prices were borne by the federal government. Our analysis illustrates that vertically integrated firms can evade profit regulation by “tunneling” profits to unregulated subsidiaries, undermining regulatory intent and increasing health care spending.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】我们提供了证据，证明垂直整合的医疗保健企业在面对保险公司利润监管时采取了战略性转移定价策略。在医疗保险D部分（Medicare Part D）实施利润上限规定后，保险公司将其在垂直整合药店中的药品价格提高了9.5%。我们发现，那些最有可能超出允许利润水平的保险公司提高了更高的价格。这些价格上涨带来的成本中，有超过五分之一由联邦政府承担。我们的分析表明，垂直整合的企业可以通过将利润“转移”至不受监管的子公司来规避利润监管，从而削弱监管效果，并增加医疗保健支出。。

papers.title: A Counterfactual Diagnostic Framework for Explaining KS Deterioration in Credit Risk Model Validation
papers.abstract: The Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) statistic is widely used in credit risk model monitoring and validation to assess discriminatory power. In practice, a material decline in KS often triggers governance review and requires validation teams to identify the breach source and the potential business risk. However, such diagnosis is frequently conducted on an ad hoc basis, relying on the judgment of individual validators rather than a standardized analytical framework. This paper proposes a counterfactual diagnostic framework for explaining KS deterioration in credit risk model validation. The framework sequentially attributes observed KS decline to sampling variability, portfolio composition change, covariate shift, and residual deterioration consistent with model drift, with explicit gateway conditions governing escalation at each stage. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach provides more interpretable and governance-relevant explanations than threshold-based review alone, and contributes to more consistent, transparent, and defensible performance-breach assessment in credit risk model validation.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）统计量在信用风险模型的监控与验证中得到广泛应用，用于评估模型的区分能力。在实际操作中，KS统计量的显著下降通常会触发治理层面的审查，要求验证团队查明问题根源及潜在的业务风险。然而，这类诊断往往基于临时性的判断进行，依赖于个别验证人员的判断而非标准化的分析框架。本文提出了一种反事实诊断框架，用于解释信用风险模型验证过程中KS统计量指标的恶化现象。该框架依次将KS统计量的下降归因于抽样误差、投资组合构成的变化、协变量偏移，以及与模型漂移相关的残差恶化，并为每个阶段的升级过程设定了明确的判断条件。仿真实验表明，与仅依赖阈值判断的审查方法相比，所提出的方法能够提供更具解释性和实用性的诊断结果，有助于实现更加一致、透明且可辩护的信用风险模型性能评估过程。。研究方法：实验方法、数值模拟。

papers.title: Structural Consequences of Policy-Based Interventions on the Global Supply Chain Network
papers.abstract: As global political tensions rise and the anticipation of additional tariffs from the United States on international trade increases, the issues of economic independence and supply chain resilience become more prominent. The importance of supply chain resilience has been further underscored by disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic and the ongoing war in Ukraine.In light of these challenges, ranging from geopolitical instability to product supply uncertainties, governments are increasingly focused on adopting new trade policies. This study explores the impact of several of these policies on the global electric vehicle (EV) supply chain network, with a particular focus on their effects on country clusters and the broader structure of international trade. Specifically, we analyse three key policies: Country Plus One, Friendshoring, and Reshoring. Our findings show that Friendshoring, contrary to expectations, leads to greater globalisation by increasing the number of supply links across friendly countries, potentially raising transaction costs. The Country Plus One policy similarly enhances network density through redundant links, while the Reshoring policy creates challenges in the EV sector due to the high number of irreplaceable products. Additionally, the effects of these policies vary across industries; for instance, mining goods being less affected in Country Plus One than the Friendshoring policy.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随着全球政治紧张局势的加剧以及人们对美国可能对国际贸易征收更多关税的担忧增加，经济独立性和供应链韧性问题变得愈发重要。新冠疫情和乌克兰持续冲突所造成的供应链中断进一步凸显了供应链韧性的重要性。面对从地缘政治不稳定到产品供应不确定性等一系列挑战，各国政府正日益重视制定新的贸易政策。本研究探讨了这些政策对全球电动汽车（EV）供应链网络的影响，特别关注它们对国家集群及国际贸易整体结构的作用。具体而言，我们分析了三项关键政策：“一国加一国”（Country Plus One）政策、“友岸外包”（Friendshoring）政策和“回流本土”（Reshoring）政策。研究结果表明，“友岸外包”政策与预期相反，通过增加友好国家之间的供应链联系反而加剧了全球化进程，可能会提高交易成本；“一国加一国”政策同样通过建立冗余供应链链接提升了网络密度；而“回流本土”政策在电动汽车行业带来了挑战，因为该行业存在大量不可替代的产品。此外，这些政策的影响因行业而异——例如，采矿产品受“一国加一国”政策的影响相对较小，而受“友岸外包”政策影响较大。。

papers.title: OOM-RL: Out-of-Money Reinforcement Learning Market-Driven Alignment for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: The alignment of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) for autonomous software engineering is constrained by evaluator epistemic uncertainty. Current paradigms, such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and AI Feedback (RLAIF), frequently induce model sycophancy, while execution-based environments suffer from adversarial "Test Evasion" by unconstrained agents. In this paper, we introduce an objective alignment paradigm: \textbf{Out-of-Money Reinforcement Learning (OOM-RL)}. By deploying agents into the non-stationary, high-friction reality of live financial markets, we utilize critical capital depletion as an un-hackable negative gradient. Our longitudinal 20-month empirical study (July 2024 -- February 2026) chronicles the system's evolution from a high-turnover, sycophantic baseline to a robust, liquidity-aware architecture. We demonstrate that the undeniable ontological consequences of financial loss forced the MAS to abandon overfitted hallucinations in favor of the \textbf{Strict Test-Driven Agentic Workflow (STDAW)}, which enforces a Byzantine-inspired uni-directional state lock (RO-Lock) anchored to a deterministically verified $\geq 95\%$ code coverage constraint matrix. Our results show that while early iterations suffered severe execution decay, the final OOM-RL-aligned system achieved a stable equilibrium with an annualized Sharpe ratio of 2.06 in its mature phase. We conclude that substituting subjective human preference with rigorous economic penalties provides a robust methodology for aligning autonomous agents in high-stakes, real-world environments, laying the groundwork for generalized paradigms where computational billing acts as an objective physical constraint
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】多智能体系统（MAS）在自主软件工程中的协同工作受到评估者认知不确定性的限制。当前的一些范式，如基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和AI反馈（RLAIF），常常导致模型出现过度谄媚的行为；而基于执行的环境则面临着来自不受约束智能体的“测试规避”攻击。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的协同工作范式：**资金耗尽型强化学习（OOM-RL）**。通过将智能体部署到充满不确定性的实时金融市场环境中，我们利用资金快速消耗这一不可被操纵的负面因素作为训练过程中的约束机制。我们进行了为期20个月（2024年7月至2026年2月）的实证研究，记录了该系统从初始的高周转率、过度谄媚的状态逐渐发展为具备良好流动性的稳健架构的演变过程。研究发现，财务损失的客观影响迫使多智能体系统摒弃了过度拟合的错误行为，转而采用**严格的测试驱动式智能体工作流程（STDAW）**；该流程采用了受拜占庭帝国启发的单向状态锁定机制（RO-Lock），并确保代码覆盖率达到至少95%。实验结果显示，尽管早期迭代阶段的系统性能大幅下降，但最终经过OM-RL优化的系统在成熟期实现了年化夏普比率为2.06的稳定运行状态。我们得出结论：用...。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: A Herding-Based Model of Technological Transfer and Economic Convergence: Evidence from Central and Eastern Europe
papers.abstract: The long-run convergence of developing economies toward advanced countries exhibits robust empirical regularities, yet the mechanisms underlying technological diffusion remain insufficiently specified in standard growth models. In this paper, we extend the neoclassical framework by introducing a micro-founded mechanism of technological transfer as a driver of total factor productivity. Rather than treating technological progress as exogenous or purely innovation-driven, we model productivity growth as a process of adopting existing technologies from the global frontier. The diffusion process is described using a herding-type interaction mechanism, in which agents transition from non-adopters to adopters under the combined influence of individual incentives and peer effects. This approach yields a tractable aggregate representation of TFP dynamics characterized by nonlinear convergence toward a moving technological frontier. We derive an explicit analytical solution and provide an interpretation of model parameters in terms of initial productivity, convergence limits, and diffusion speed. The model is evaluated using OECD productivity data for Central and Eastern European economies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】发展中国家经济向发达国家长期趋同的现象表现出显著的实证规律性，然而标准增长模型中对技术扩散的机制描述仍然不够充分。在本文中，我们通过引入基于微观经济原理的技术转移机制来扩展新古典框架，将其作为全要素生产率（TFP）增长的驱动力。我们不再将技术进步视为外生因素或纯粹由创新驱动的过程，而是将其建模为从全球技术前沿采纳现有技术的过程。技术扩散过程通过一种“羊群效应”类型的互动机制来描述：在个体激励和同伴效应的共同作用下，未采纳技术的主体会转变为采纳技术的主体。这种方法能够以一种易于处理的方式描述TFP动态，其特征是经济逐渐向不断移动的技术前沿非线性收敛。我们推导出了模型的显式解析解，并从初始生产率、收敛极限和扩散速度等方面对模型参数进行了解释。该模型使用了经合组织（OECD）关于中欧和东欧经济体的生产率数据进行了验证。。
